controllers: discrete positional PID with dt guard

control_meaning: control engineering (dynamical systems/feedback), NOT subsystem orchestration; see docs/CONTROL_MODEL.md disambiguation

history.obsolete_paths_removed: none existed; no parallel implementations created

loop_model: LoopState { x, ctl }; full-state measurement; y = x; estimators/output maps are future layers
native_coverage: all control semantics are MNCS; host code is Python oracle + runner only
numeric_discipline: exact == on dyadic trajectories; no approx needed in this slice

orchestration_foil.actions_boundary: no providers defined; PID step is not an Action
orchestration_foil.control_mcp: separate orchestration plane; no integration follow-up; read-only, unmodified
orchestration_foil.forge_boundary: no scheduling/queues; future tuning work would use Control request -> Forge -> ExecutionId
orchestration_foil.naming_action: qualify future uses of 'control' for orchestration concepts

pid_form: e = r - y; D = (e - prev)/dt; I += e*dt; raw = Kp*e + Ki*I + Kd*D; u = clamp(raw); freeze I when saturated and err*raw > 0

C-001.summary: `next` reserved; patterns bind declared field names (MNP064/MNE177/MNE179)

C-002.summary: no clock observation; wall-clock deadlines stay behind host adapters

C-003.summary: f64-specific controllers; generic scalars share geometry G-001 root cause

C-004.summary: impossible match arms need total stand-ins

read_vs_mutate: every Control operation is a pure bounded function; no side effects by construction; no long-running ops, no cancellation, no query/refresh ambiguity
timing_model: dt is validated data (dt > 0), never a clock read; real-time contract is bounded deterministic per-sample work
unknowns: second-order plant + discretization-method choice (ZOH vs Tustin)

verification.degenerate_models: all structured (BadDt/BadLimits/saturation flags/observed instability), none trapping
verification.oracle: tools/oracle_pid.py exact-rational + float-bit checks (zero shared code)
